## Exercise 1: R Basics

### 1.1 Create Variables

```{r}
# Patient age (45 years)
patient_age <- 45

# Drug dosage (2.5 mg)
drug_dose <- 2.5

# Sample ID ("SAMPLE_001")
sample_id <- "SAMPLE_001"
```

### 1.2 Create a Vector

```{r}
bp_readings <- c(120, 135, 118, 142, 128, 131)

# Calculate the mean
mean_bp <- mean(bp_readings)
mean_bp

# Calculate the standard deviation
sd_bp <- sd(bp_readings)
sd_bp
```

### 1.3 Create a Data Frame

```{r}
patients <- data.frame(
  id = c("P001", "P002", "P003", "P004"),
  age = c(45, 32, 58, 41),
  treatment = c("Drug A", "Placebo", "Drug A", "Placebo")
)
patients
```

## Exercise 2: dplyr Practice

### 2.1 Filter

```{r}
mtcars |>
  filter(cyl > 6)
```

### 2.2 Select

```{r}
mtcars |>
  select(mpg, cyl, hp)
```

### 2.3 Mutate

```{r}
mtcars |>
  mutate(kpl = mpg * 0.425) |>
  select(mpg, kpl)
```

### 2.4 Arrange

```{r}
mtcars |>
  arrange(desc(mpg)) |>
  head(5)
```

### 2.5 Summarize

```{r}
mtcars |>
  group_by(cyl) |>
  summarize(
    mean_mpg = mean(mpg),
    sd_mpg = sd(mpg),
    n = n()
  )
```

---

## Exercise 3: ggplot2 Basics

### 3.1 Scatter Plot

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point()
```

### 3.2 Add Color

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point()
```

### 3.3 Add Labels

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs Vehicle Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per Gallon"
  )
```

### 3.4 Box Plot

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = factor(cyl), y = mpg)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  theme_classic()
```

### 3.5 Complete Figure

```{r}
ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  labs(
    title = "Fuel Efficiency vs Weight",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "MPG",
    color = "Cylinders"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

## Bonus Challenge

```{r}
# 1. Filter for setosa
setosa_data <- iris |>
  filter(Species == "setosa")

# 2. Calculate means
setosa_data |>
  summarize(
    mean_sepal = mean(Sepal.Length),
    mean_petal = mean(Petal.Length)
  )

# 3. Scatter plot
ggplot(setosa_data, aes(x = Sepal.Length, y = Petal.Length)) +
  geom_point(color = "forestgreen") +
  labs(
    title = "Setosa: Sepal vs Petal Length",
    x = "Sepal Length (cm)",
    y = "Petal Length (cm)"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```
